notes.title: 🚧Quality of Life Boost - Big Impact🚧
notes.content:
Hey, Junkers!👷👋

Thanks to your continued feedback and support, we’ve introduced a bunch of quality-of-life improvements and important fixes to streamline your junkyard operations! 🧰🚛

Hotfix list:
🛠️ Added the ability to close the confirmation message about enabling the loader using the ESC key on the keyboard and the corresponding button on the gamepad. This allows for emergency closure of the message and provides a more convenient option for players who prefer using ESC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/eb2aca46095b8167001384296ae6b19bcd616680.jpg
🛠️ A new feature has been introduced allowing players to close the message about vehicle wreck reset or processed scrap cube in the loader using the ESC key and the corresponding gamepad button. This enables emergency dismissal of the message and is more convenient for players who prefer using ESC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/06a4af3a41592f6fb371513917ca06d8391dce14.jpg
🛠️ It is now possible to close the message about the loader position reset using the ESC key and the corresponding gamepad button. This allows for emergency message closure and offers a more convenient option for ESC users.

🛠️ Interaction with the wreck unloading panel no longer requires directly looking at it. notes.title: Quests and tutorial changes - Big Update!
notes.content:
Hey, as you know, we are constantly working on the game. Update 2.2.3 includes big changes to the quests and tutorial - Just like asked/requested. 

It is shorter and more specific. Of course, we ask for feedback!  ːsteamhappyː

Below is also a list of fixes that the update contains.

Hotfix:


 Better story quest flow
 Speed ​​up string loading when throwing boxes (plot) by 30-40%
 Get rid of these subtasks from Quest so the bug is "fixed":
BUG: Quest 8 - 6/7 - Clean armchair and put down brush. - So I got the brush via pressing ALT and selecting it instead of picking up the brush in the world. I've sold the chair to the guy so now the mission is locked at "clean armchair and put down brush" - Great.
 Add a block on the ability to purchase vehicle auto renovation skills and items until it causes a blocker (i.e. after the blue vehicle quest). Players reported the problem.
 Adding Hud to vehicles - several players did not know how to turn on the lights of a car/stroller, rooster, etc..
 Changing the button for hints when searching and dismantling the challenger from i to H
 Fixed an error where, after loading the game and the player has a delivery on the Lot, instead of seeing a list of items, a counter for the next delivery is shown
 Unlocking the ability to sell in the Pawnshop after completing the task of delivering a chair and wine to Grandma
 Improved the location of the actor to be cleaned with a broom on the Lot in Area E. Due to his location, he was difficult to notice - players reported
 Fixed a bug that made it possible to obtain a duplicate car when we had a vehicle pulled to the lift and were pulling another vehicle from the tow truck to replace it
 Repair of endless sound and thus blocking of the crane raising or lowering during vehicle renovation
 A cart that starts moving backwards on its own and never stops. This is random but regular (EDIT: the bug also occurred forward, but already fixed - from my tests at least asking for verification)
 Fixed misleading information regarding lot condition and lot cleanliness bonuses
 Add additional security to completing the quest with a fast trip to the scrapyard
 Fixed a bug that caused some players to lose the 16 slot upgrade in Pickup. Even though they had purchased and selected the 16-slot Pickup upgrade, there were still 12 slots
 Fixed upgrade errors regarding the truck with a crate, the blue version had 24 slots on the first upgrade level, and 16 slots on the second upgrade level
 Change the picture and inscription for the first basic version of the Pickup and Truck vehicles that we get - it is not possible to expand more slots, and the pictures suggest this
 Fixed the Cart Reset quest, now you don't have to go to the indicated place and you can reset the cart anywhere to complete the quest from the beginning of the game
 Fixing the crash blocker due to the wrong location - Goala in the new plot quest
 Reducing the amount of raw tiles from the kiln for the Cutting Station - Goala in the new plot quest
 Add the text "Optionally use a car to get there" in each language for the "Buy plots" subtask - Goala before the plot quest
 Remove the signal showing the widget regarding information about the plot once again, now there is only this one when receiving the task after cleaning 3 things in the trash - before the plot quest
 Fixed items remaining at the bottom of the stock frame after clicking the send frame button
 Fixed completing Quest with delivering items after transporting them to the exchange by tape. If we weren't near the cage and were just throwing, he didn't count Quest
 Changing the location of the "Soap Machine" when completing a task involving collecting an item to be transported to the conveyor belt
 Improve the raw materials selling widget
 Fix a bug that changed the appearance of the lift reset widget buttons [X]
 Improve the visibility of the inscription when inserting the item into the renovation station
 Challenger Blue shader repair. After renovation, when it is renovated, shiny elements have a strange reflection error effect
 Get rid of the last stage of renovation of the rear and front fender when restoring Chllanger Blue. The last stage involves only applying roughness, and this is not visible while playing
 Removed the dialogue about the mini map during the task with scanning the area and collecting $27k
 Increase the size of the image in the lost and found information widget, because nothing can be seen in the current one due to its size
 Speed ​​up the opening and closing of automatic gates in a large scrap yard
 Preventing random completion of the conversation with Grandma task after pressing LMB
 Securing a possible blocker while we need to talk to Grandma and she will leave the quest area
 Adding content to the taskbar after purchasing a container saying: "optional - take items from the container and sell them, renovate them if you want to make money"
 Adding protection to the floor of the container to prevent items from flying through the floor during purchase
 Fixed the collision of pawnshop items that were flying through the container floor
 Changed the order of Quests, now the Crusher quest occurs after the quest to collect $27k. So it is now task 8 instead of task 14
 An almost complete change in the order of Quests from Quest 8 to Quest 13. Aimed at accelerating the player's contact with the most interesting game mechanics. Now the order is as follows:
	Quest 8 - Using stationary press
	Quest 9 - Win the Old Lady's trust - she runs an illegal pawnshop
	Quest 10 - Fast Travel
	Quest 11 - Find abandoned camp upon Lucy's instructions
	Quest 12 - At the end of one of the sections
	Quest 13 - Felix recommends buying a container
 Quest 11 - Find abandoned camp upon Lucy's instructions - Remove the subtask and return the items from the quest to the table
 Change the font of the NPC dialogue texts to the same font used when talking to Bob on the phone
 Add an inscription in the Crusher task: "Press Alt and select hammer or [4]"
 Fix the Ice Cream in the Van because it's very ugly even up close
 Add screen dimming when entering Crusher so that huds do not overlap
 Adding a hint in the form of highlighting a button in the plot plan when doing the Plot Quest
 Added a hint arrow in the expansion tab when doing the Lot Quest
 Fixing the icons on the plot plan, because they all have the position 0 0 0, i.e. in the lower left corner
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused processing to stop at 99% in Crusher even though more than 100% of the raw material had been added
 Changed Crusher mechanics, now after finishing pressing, all the raw material goes to the Created Scrap Box, so that there are no leftovers of raw material at the end that need to be processed next time
 Repair of the Scrap Box created in Crusher after pressing scrap, which could get stuck in place and could not be moved
 Improve the graphics of scrap filling inside the Crusher in the 2D graphic in the lower right corner
 Fixed counting of resources contained in items. Now the correct values ​​are displayed, consistent with the amount we receive at the scrap exchange
 Fixed a blockage that may occur for some players during tasks involving loading items into the vehicle's bed
 Add a protection that when resetting vehicles in case they are not in the game due to some error - will restore them to the game
 Fixed all problems caused by loading an older save with quests in the old order
 Fixed the possibility of a vehicle falling into the crusher in such a way that it would not be counted for processing at all

notes.title: Hotfix v.2.1.3 - Update
notes.content:
Further game optimization increased the FPS from 4 up to 12, depending on the location in the game. We are constantly working on it. The game increased fluidity, and we got rid of many stutterings – which we will keep fixing until release.

We changed and optimized the shader system on objects. Now they are loading much faster and display textures in higher quality.

We decreased the game’s size from 21GB to 14GB, which will affect the download speed of updates - something longed for by players who have lower bandwidth.

We fixed the issue with mouse sensitivity settings not being saved.

Many minor UI fixes, connecting more game elements to the controller, etc.

We are about 60% done with moving mechanics from the old engine to a new one. Work is going well, and you should expect another big update at the end of January. We need more time for tests because testers have not checked the mechanics yet. As you all know, December is a time to catch a breath before kicking off with new energy next year.

We will share the early build on the testing branch when we get a green light.

notes.title: Junkyard Devlog - World Map and Exploration
notes.content:
Hello!

We’re back with some new info about Junkyard Simulator. As you might know, we’re still testing and improving our game to give you the best possible experience. In the meantime, we would like to show you various gameplay elements. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/3985d6201f45ecd5c90273fc7d136926cb40f447.png


Today, we would like to introduce you to the map and exploration of the world.


MAP

Junkyard Simulator is an experience based on instant searching for the most interesting scrap, parts of the machines and other various items to process, renovate or sale. If you want your business to grow you should be aware of your surroundings. That is why we want to enrich the gameplay by giving you a large map to explore. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/fbba6509fa6bf04b6de16d38810218d2c8fca517.jpg

Large Map will give you detailed information about the game area. You’ll be able to get a better lay of the land and plan your routes efficiently. You should keep in mind that it offers a lot of interesting locations with loot to find. 


CART 

As you can find a lot of scrap in the surrounding areas, you will need something more than a backpack to transport it. The cart will be perfect at the beginning of your adventure - take it and load what you can. It will be a good setup for developing your business and earning some money to afford better vehicles.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/20519cd469f439e19b4ebe4c539bd31d5e0671d3.jpg


Unfortunately, it is hard to pick up girls with that… but Lucy will be very helpful in expanding your junky empire by giving you some quests ^^


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/773ed80789a3f7458b6fb2e8dbdf78e2c6b833a6.jpg


LOCATIONS

While exploring the open world of Junkyard simulator you will find various locations for scavenging. Check abandoned buildings in the forest, visit junkyards of your fellow NPC’s and unlock new skills or game mechanics by completing quests in different places.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/1e4621508deacccd950c27ada0d8305eb7044cf6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/325f4f1ae2c8e7336cb67822b2bf1ab299f279bc.jpg


Hello, little squirrel!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/ba861d0a8a68f5195bc492f90363187746615ce5.jpg


Sometimes you will be able to explore some more complex locations when it comes to the search for proper loot. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/6e024c6daf1edb7cad5d1af8821485ea6bc09a5f.jpg


If you don’t want to use the map all the time you can also pay attention to signs that will help in navigating the area.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/bec67d20f6c21c3af570e119cc2b6ef92b4c8ee4.jpg


And finally, we're working hard to give you also some nice views :) 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/22efc28b106fb0c5f330db7220a0a9f0ba9571a5.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/cd49bdeab99c30e0c19295edf50f44b513be7575.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/2c8c550d65150d597cd5e34897ffd7233415910f.jpg


We would like to share some more info about the gameplay features in upcoming devlogs so stay tuned! Thank you for your patience and support for our game! <3

Yours,
Dev Team

notes.title: Weekly GameDev update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/35154fae9534d2409441bcd6778257b347f40d18.jpg

We’re working on better game optimization and fixing small bugs. Here is a list from last week:

- We rebuild game scaling mechanisms and resolution settings.
- In Quest 3 we fixed a bug blocking the completing the task
- We’ve solved problems with display mode settings for non-native display resolution.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/3cdd401dcf887f76ab259d525811cc767450920e.jpg
 
- We’ve fixed a bug with bear and the quest.
- We’ve eliminated all the places indicated by testers where the gamer can get stuck somehow.
- We’ve completed the missing collisions spaces/walls in the junky house (the optimization script wasn’t fully read)
- Now all quests texts are fitted to the window.
- We improved item counting in the starter container and we added dust particles and sound of counting.
- We've fixed the order of messages displaying.
- We added extra space for the description in the tutorial menu. Before now it was displayed on the video what was hard to read. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/642b56398b93bd7d6d407b24d66f1c868d311026.jpg

- Grid alignment in the whole UI and main menu
- We solved the problem with keys and the gate after leaving the barrack (now the gate is openable).
- Dialog skipping is automatic (after a few seconds). It can be turned off in the game settings.
- The hand brake is pulled automatically after getting out of the car. So now there is no possibility of “jumping off the car” during the ride. 
- We have fixed a bug of blocking the player after jumping off from the overturned cart.
- In the main menu of the game, after playing the trailer we had a problem with sound on the intro. Now the problem is solved. 
- We have improved the graphic scale for ~75 items
- We cut the time of displaying tutorial on the screen.
- UI update for all vehicles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/162e363bbcd2bdcc7f4f49566aba6d7158faf8fa.jpg

And much more which were hard to explain without knowledge about the gameplay and the storyline.

notes.title: Weekly GameDev update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/e12ffa7c4349537c3d53a6ceef2d08300c5412d6.jpg

1. After suggestions from QA, we’ve rebuild the UI of minimap and notebook. From now the map and notebook are available after pressing [TAB].
2. We swap action between [F] and [E].
3. We proceed to rebuild the level by connecting the viaduct with the main road and access road to the workshop.
4. On QA request we added new signposts to make navigating and moving on the level much easier.
5. We developed a Backpack for 12 items with graphic design and the pictures of the items. Now the gameplay is nicer. You can use a cart for 7-14 items with the backpack with 12 empty slots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/047e94a2ca08122e0c26d5d3b778d6d2a7de27ba.jpg

6. The game is scaled up to 4K.
7. We’ve added a story to the game with a voice actor.
8. Bug fixing for tutorials and quests.
9. Now the cart garage is closer to the start point of the game.
10. We implemented such languages like: English 100%, Polish 100%, German: 50%, Spanish: 100%, Russian: 100%.
11. Optimizing graphics performance. We added an option for changing the quality of the graphics. From now you can change the range of pixel density and adjust the post-processing for the lower settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/06f83b8455f58c5f66749c6efac4ceb5e832bbb5.jpg

12. Savepoint system has been improved. You can save the game between sub-quests and anytime during the task. All items from the backpack and the nearest Junkman arena will be remembered for your next playing session. But at the same time, the game will be filled up with new random items whenever you’re restarting the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/ab9d1db6a9cd92b42366279eab0b066040aaefc4.jpg

13. The keyboard logic and steering are refined.
14. Minimap bug fixing.
15. As Robert suggested, from now you have a possibility of recalling the cart by pressing one button.
16. All the places where the player could be blocked somehow are fixed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29480609/20e562724f1ba28642fd26866d0c4d0f2c975291.jpg

17. We redesigned the tutorial window by adding arrows and making the list more useful.
18. The gameplay has better guiding. In all key moments, you will hear Bob's voice, your main client.
19. We simplified the user interface after QA suggestions.
